I still think this is a change worth making, but let me know that the more defeq abuse involving Finsupp we remove, the easier this change will be. It will also be easier if Finsupp and DFinsupp are unified.
What would be the first step to unifying Finsupp & DFinsupp?
Aligning their APIs (including the file layouts) is something that can be done today
And reducing the (ab)uses of Finsupp (as I am referring to above) will also help
A fun way to get the refactor done would be to switch each use of Finsupp one by one to DFinsupp, until there are no uses anymore
